annotations.text:
Backdrop: the zoo-entrance image with the app's exact crop — the stock preview's watermark band is held below the frame. It is a VectorStock PREVIEW; the submission needs the licensed export.

Every drawing here is lifted from src/components/animals.tsx as shipped — same paths, same sizes (220px owned, 170px silhouette), same 22% ghost opacity.

Owned animals sway and blink on this canvas exactly as in the app. Nothing responds to an answer; the tapped card still gets only the neutral gold.

Between the game and the parent screen. The child is still holding the device, and the parent screen names a reading difficulty — so the session ends HERE, in the child's zoo, and the parent screen is reached only by tapping Show a grown-up.

Nothing evaluative: no score, no count, no price tags on the empty pens. Same two lines whether the child got everything right or everything wrong.
Habitats are assigned by animal (lion → grass, elephant → water, giraffe → trees, penguin → rock). Ground sits behind the animal, the boundary in front.
